title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider how the model's flexibility changes.

title: Effect of Adding a Feature
text: What happens to the model's ability to fit the training data when you add a new feature?

title: Model Complexity and Training MSE
text: Adding a feature can increase the model's complexity. A more complex model can fit the training data more closely. How might this affect the training MSE?

title: Training MSE and Model Complexity
text: Does increasing model complexity generally increase or decrease the training MSE?
